_provenance.notes: Single-page (uplift --single) capture. Tokens read from the live :root custom properties (aem-boilerplate styles.css) plus computed cross-section colors. Palette roles verified against the full-page screenshot.

logo.notes: Stylized mascot mark in two brand fills — gold #e8cf6c and sage #6b8a7c — beside the 'CÉLINE KNOBLOCH / Trier · Ranger · Optimiser' lockup.

primary.notes: Muted sage green — links, buttons, testimonial band.

primaryDeep.notes: Slightly deeper sage used in the logo mark.

accent.notes: Golden yellow — link-hover only. Reserved, high-energy shade.

accentGold.notes: Gold used in the logo mark.

surfaceWarm.notes: Soft warm gold band — the 'Pourquoi faire appel' section and footer pre-band. Used as a large surface twice.

palette.notes: Two-hue warm palette: sage green + golden yellow on cream. Gold appears both reserved (link-hover) and as a large calm surface (#f8e1af band). Green appears as the primary interactive + one large surface (testimonial).

body.name: Comfortaa
body.stack: 'Comfortaa', 'helvetica neue', helvetica, ubuntu, roboto, noto, sans-serif
body.notes: Rounded geometric sans — soft, friendly, low-contrast.

heading.name: Comfortaa
heading.stack: 'Comfortaa', 'helvetica neue', helvetica, ubuntu, roboto, noto, sans-serif
heading.notes: Same family as body — no display contrast in the type system except the script.

display.name: Sacramento
display.notes: Flowing single-weight cursive script. Captured in exactly ONE place: the hero H1 tagline 'Le rangement au service de votre bien-être!'. Signature voice, radically underused.

scaleAudit.notes: Standard aem-boilerplate modular scale. Heading and body share the Comfortaa family so hierarchy leans on size/weight alone.

borderRadius.notes: Pill buttons (En savoir plus, Contactez-moi) reinforce the rounded Comfortaa voice.

shadow.notes: Minimal — soft or none; flat calm surfaces.

signatureGestures: Script tagline in Sacramento over the hero photo (single use).
Mascot logo mark (gold + sage) — appears only in the header.
Warm gold full-bleed bands (#f8e1af) used to segment long-form 'why' content.

voice.heroHeadline: Le rangement au service de votre bien-être !
samples: J'aide les personnes qui ont envie de trier, ranger, désencombrer leur maison et organiser leur lieu de vie.
En tant que coach en rangement, je guide mes clients vers une organisation qui LEUR convient et qui est maintenable dans la durée.
Mon sens de l'écoute et mes qualités relationnelles me permettent de vous aider à lever certains blocages psychologiques...
Forte de mon expérience passée en tant qu'infirmière, c'est avec douceur et bienveillance que je vous accompagnerai.

toneAxes.dominant: warm / caring / reassuring (bien-être, douceur, bienveillance, sérénité, écoute)
toneAxes.underused: method / practical process (tri, méthodes de travail, visite diagnostic, devis, mission, maintenable dans la durée) — present in 'Comment ça se passe ?' but never foregrounded

assets.notes: Real environmental portrait of Céline — smiling, in a styled warm living room (plant, teal cushions, cream sweater). Genuine brand identity photography, NOT generic stock.

photography.notes: Exactly one high-quality identity photo captured; it carries the entire warmth of the brand yet the layout crops it into a single wide hero band and never reuses photography elsewhere on the page.

header.notes: Logo lockup + horizontal nav: Accueil · Qui suis-je ? · Prestations et Tarifs · Mes Réalisations · Contact. nav-height 96px.

footer.notes: © Céline Knobloch, 2025 · Tél 06 32 73 18 98 · Mail contact@celinek.org · Instagram + Facebook icons, on a warm gold band.
